mapper.sql: (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(j.`project_id` ORDER BY j.`project_id` SEPARATOR ',') FROM `data_file_projects` j WHERE j.`file_id` = f.`id`) AS project_ids, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(p.`name` ORDER BY j2.`project_id` SEPARATOR '、') FROM `data_file_projects` j2 JOIN `projects` p ON p.`id` = j2.`project_id` WHERE j2.`file_id` = f.`id`) AS project_names
mapper.select:
SELECT f.`id`, f.`name`, f.`path`, f.`file_type`, f.`file_size`, f.`content_hash`, f.`organism`, f.`genome_version`, f.`uploaded_by`, f.`created_at`,
FROM `data_files` f WHERE f.`id` = #{id}

SELECT f.`id`, f.`name`, f.`path`, f.`file_type`, f.`file_size`, f.`content_hash`, f.`organism`, f.`genome_version`, f.`uploaded_by`, f.`created_at`, , u.`username` AS uploader_name FROM `data_files` f JOIN `data_file_projects` j ON j.`file_id` = f.`id` AND j.`project_id` = #{projectId} LEFT JOIN `users` u ON f.`uploaded_by` = u.`id`
AND f.`file_type` = #{fileType}
AND f.`name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY f.`created_at` DESC

SELECT FROM `data_files` WHERE `name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `data_file_projects` j WHERE j.`file_id` = `data_files`.`id` AND j.`project_id` = #{projectId})
AND `file_type` = #{fileType}
ORDER BY `created_at` DESC

SELECT f.`id`, f.`name`, f.`path`, f.`file_type`, f.`file_size`, f.`content_hash`, f.`organism`, f.`genome_version`, f.`uploaded_by`, f.`created_at`, , u.`username` AS uploader_name FROM `data_files` f LEFT JOIN `users` u ON f.`uploaded_by` = u.`id` WHERE f.`content_hash` = #{contentHash} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `data_file_projects` j WHERE j.`file_id` = f.`id` AND j.`project_id` = #{projectId}) ORDER BY f.`id` DESC LIMIT 1
